records.primary_i_can: I can calculate average speed from distance and time.

records.student_action: navigate a coherent multipart FRQ by using one shared stimulus and carrying earlier information into a later part

requirements: compact width for small data sets

records.length_intent: fit evidence job; WTC may be multipart
records.authoring_notes: WTC is decomposition/navigation practice, not current-Unit coverage.
records.shared_stimulus_contract: one coherent shared stimulus used across all labeled parts
planned_parts: (a) identify the given/asked quantities from the shared table
(b) extract the relevant distance/time evidence
(c) determine the average speed from that shared evidence
(d) use the result from part (c) in a new-distance prediction
dependency_chain: later part uses a result/conclusion/representation from the preceding part
records.accessibility_plan: Future Section 2.2 content is made accessible by supplying the average-speed relationship and keeping arithmetic straightforward.

records.length_intent: fit evidence job; WTC may be multipart
